```{r Plot by Gender Bottom 10% Severity}

#this code does not generate top 10% as there are not enough values...error in way data was merged?

# --- Libraries ---
library(arrow)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

```
```{r}
# --- 1. Load demo and MDS data ---
demo_data <- fread("C:/Users/teger/Downloads/Parkinson's Data/Demographic Survey.csv") %>%
  select(healthCode, gender, recordId)

MDS_data <- fread("C:/Users/teger/Downloads/Parkinson's Data/MDS-UPDRS Data.csv")

```

```{r}

part_one <- MDS_data %>%
  select(healthCode, recordId, starts_with("MDS.UPDRS1")) %>%
  mutate(nonmotor = rowSums(across(starts_with("MDS.UPDRS1")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  select(healthCode, recordId, nonmotor)

part_two <- MDS_data %>%
  select(healthCode, recordId, starts_with("MDS.UPDRS2")) %>%
  mutate(motor = rowSums(across(starts_with("MDS.UPDRS2")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  select(healthCode, recordId, motor)

# Aggregate MDS to one row per healthCode
MD_unique <- left_join(part_one, part_two, by = "healthCode") %>%
  group_by(healthCode) %>%
  summarise(
    motor = mean(motor, na.rm = TRUE),
    nonmotor = mean(nonmotor, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 2. Open Parquet datasets lazily ---
neg_ds <- open_dataset("C:/Users/teger/Downloads/negative (5).parquet")
pos_ds <- open_dataset("C:/Users/teger/Downloads/positive (4).parquet")

# --- 3. DuckDB connection ---
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir=":memory:")

duckdb_register_arrow(con, "neg_dd", neg_ds)
duckdb_register_arrow(con, "pos_dd", pos_ds)

# --- 4. Compute min/max time lazily ---
neg_time <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT MIN(time) AS tmin, MAX(time) AS tmax FROM neg_dd")
pos_time <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT MIN(time) AS tmin, MAX(time) AS tmax FROM pos_dd")

# --- 5. Aggregate F0-F3 per healthCode (memory-efficient) ---
neg_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
  SELECT healthCode,
  recordId,
         AVG(F0) AS F0,
         AVG(F1) AS F1,
         AVG(F2) AS F2,
         AVG(F3) AS F3,
         AVG((time - %f)/(%f - %f)) AS time_norm,
         'neg' AS source
  FROM neg_dd
  GROUP BY recordId, healthCode
", neg_time$tmin, neg_time$tmax, neg_time$tmin)) %>% as.data.table()

pos_summary <- dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
  SELECT healthCode,
  recordId,
         AVG(F0) AS F0,
         AVG(F1) AS F1,
         AVG(F2) AS F2,
         AVG(F3) AS F3,
         AVG((time - %f)/(%f - %f)) AS time_norm,
         'pos' AS source
  FROM pos_dd
  GROUP BY healthCode, recordId
", pos_time$tmin, pos_time$tmax, pos_time$tmin)) %>% as.data.table()

all_summary <- rbindlist(list(neg_summary, pos_summary), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

# --- 6. Merge with demo & MDS data ---
all_merged <- all_summary %>%
  left_join(demo_data, by = c("healthCode", "recordId")) %>%
  left_join(MD_unique, by = c("healthCode")) %>%
  as.data.table()
```

```{r}
# --- 7. Compute top/bottom 10% thresholds ---
q_motor <- quantile(all_merged$motor, c(0.1, 0.9), na.rm = TRUE)
q_nonmotor <- quantile(all_merged$nonmotor, c(0.1, 0.9), na.rm = TRUE)

# --- 8. Keep motor_group and nonmotor_group as separate columns ---
all_merged[, motor_group := fifelse(motor <= q_motor[1], "bottom10",
                                    fifelse(motor >= q_motor[2], "top10", NA_character_))]
all_merged[, nonmotor_group := fifelse(nonmotor <= q_nonmotor[1], "bottom10",
                                       fifelse(nonmotor >= q_nonmotor[2], "top10", NA_character_))]

# --- 9. Reshape for plotting ---
plot_data <- melt(
  all_merged,
  id.vars = c("healthCode", "gender", "source", "F0","F1","F2","F3"),
  measure.vars = c("motor_group","nonmotor_group"),
  variable.name = "ScoreType",
  value.name = "Group"
)

# --- 10. Keep only top/bottom 10% rows ---
plot_data <- plot_data[!is.na(Group)]

# --- 11. Melt F0-F3 into long format ---
plot_data_long <- melt(
  plot_data,
  id.vars = c("healthCode","gender","source","ScoreType","Group"),
  measure.vars = c("F0","F1","F2","F3"),
  variable.name = "Feature",
  value.name = "Value"
)

# --- 11. Plot ---
ggplot(plot_data_long, aes(x = Group, y = Value, fill = gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(Feature ~ ScoreType, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(ScoreType = c("motor_group"="Motor","nonmotor_group"="Nonmotor"))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "F0-F3 by Top/Bottom 10% Motor and Nonmotor Scores",
    x = "Score Group",
    y = "Feature Value",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r recordId and healthCode in MDS_data overlap check}
diagnose_overlap <- function(con, demo_data, MDS_data, neg_ds, pos_ds) {

  cat("\n=============================\n")
  cat(" COLUMN PRESENCE CHECK\n")
  cat("=============================\n")

  neg_cols <- colnames(neg_ds)
  pos_cols <- colnames(pos_ds)

  cat("neg_ds columns:\n"); print(neg_cols)
  cat("pos_ds columns:\n"); print(pos_cols)

  has_record_neg <- "recordId" %in% neg_cols
  has_record_pos <- "recordId" %in% pos_cols

  has_hc_neg <- "healthCode" %in% neg_cols
  has_hc_pos <- "healthCode" %in% pos_cols

  cat("\nContains recordId?\n")
  print(c(neg = has_record_neg, pos = has_record_pos))

  cat("\nContains healthCode?\n")
  print(c(neg = has_hc_neg, pos = has_hc_pos))

  cat("\n=============================\n")
  cat(" DISTINCT HEALTHCODE & RECORDID\n")
  cat("=============================\n")

  # local (R) dataset counts
  cat("\nDistinct healthCodes (demo): ", length(unique(demo_data$healthCode)))
  cat("\nDistinct healthCodes (MDS):  ", length(unique(MDS_data$healthCode)), "\n")

  # parquet (healthCode)
  neg_hc <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT healthCode) AS n FROM neg_dd")
  pos_hc <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT healthCode) AS n FROM pos_dd")

  cat("\nDistinct healthCodes (neg): "); print(neg_hc)
  cat("Distinct healthCodes (pos): "); print(pos_hc)

  # recordId counts
  if (has_record_neg) {
    neg_rec <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT recordId) AS n FROM neg_dd")
    cat("Distinct recordIds (neg): "); print(neg_rec)
  } else {
    cat("neg_dd has NO recordId column.\n")
  }

  if (has_record_pos) {
    pos_rec <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT recordId) AS n FROM pos_dd")
    cat("Distinct recordIds (pos): "); print(pos_rec)
  } else {
    cat("pos_dd has NO recordId column.\n")
  }

  cat("\n=============================\n")
  cat(" HEALTHCODE OVERLAP ACROSS DATASETS\n")
  cat("=============================\n")

  # Demo ↔ MDS (R–R)
  overlap_demo_mds <- length(intersect(demo_data$healthCode, MDS_data$healthCode))
  cat("\nDemo ↔ MDS healthCode overlap:", overlap_demo_mds, "\n")

  # Demo ↔ neg (R–DuckDB)
  overlap_demo_neg <- dbGetQuery(con,"
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS overlap
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT healthCode FROM neg_dd
      INTERSECT
      SELECT DISTINCT healthCode FROM demo_data
    )
  ")
  cat("\nDemo ↔ Neg overlap:\n"); print(overlap_demo_neg)

  # Demo ↔ pos
  overlap_demo_pos <- dbGetQuery(con,"
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS overlap
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT healthCode FROM pos_dd
      INTERSECT
      SELECT DISTINCT healthCode FROM demo_data
    )
  ")
  cat("\nDemo ↔ Pos overlap:\n"); print(overlap_demo_pos)

  cat("\n=============================\n")
  cat(" RECORDID ↔ HEALTHCODE CONSISTENCY\n")
  cat("=============================\n")

  if (has_record_neg) {
    cat("\nNeg_dd recordId–healthCode pairs:\n")
    print(dbGetQuery(con, "
      SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT recordId) AS unique_records,
        COUNT(DISTINCT healthCode) AS unique_codes,
        COUNT(DISTINCT recordId || '-' || healthCode) AS unique_pairs
      FROM neg_dd
    "))
  }

  if (has_record_pos) {
    cat("\nPos_dd recordId–healthCode pairs:\n")
    print(dbGetQuery(con, "
      SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT recordId) AS unique_records,
        COUNT(DISTINCT healthCode) AS unique_codes,
        COUNT(DISTINCT recordId || '-' || healthCode) AS unique_pairs
      FROM pos_dd
    "))
  }

  cat("\n=============================\n")
  cat(" END OF DIAGNOSTICS\n")
  cat("=============================\n")
}
```

```{r reorganized code}
#reorganization to include top 10% 
#this version meant to reduce memory usage but I still ran out of storage on my computer before I could see if it actually works
#i don't think this one accounts for normalizaiton the time values though 

library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(DBI)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Small top/bottom 10% table
MDS_data <- fread("C:/Users/teger/Downloads/Parkinson's Data/MDS-UPDRS Data.csv")

MD_scores <- MDS_data %>%
  mutate(
    nonmotor = rowSums(across(starts_with("MDS.UPDRS1")), na.rm = TRUE),
    motor = rowSums(across(starts_with("MDS.UPDRS2")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(healthCode, recordId, motor, nonmotor)

score_labels <- MD_scores %>%
  mutate(
    motor_group = case_when(
      motor <= quantile(motor, 0.1, na.rm=TRUE) ~ "bottom10",
      motor >= quantile(motor, 0.9, na.rm=TRUE) ~ "top10",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    nonmotor_group = case_when(
      nonmotor <= quantile(nonmotor, 0.1, na.rm=TRUE) ~ "bottom10",
      nonmotor >= quantile(nonmotor, 0.9, na.rm=TRUE) ~ "top10",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(motor_group) | !is.na(nonmotor_group)) %>%
  select(healthCode, motor_group, nonmotor_group)

# 2. DuckDB connection
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir=":memory:")

# 3. Create Parquet views
DBI::dbExecute(con, "CREATE VIEW neg AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('C:/Users/teger/R Studio Stuff/negative (5).parquet')")
DBI::dbExecute(con, "CREATE VIEW pos AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('C:/Users/teger/R Studio Stuff/positive (4).parquet')")

# 4. Copy score_labels to DuckDB
copy_to(con, score_labels, "score_labels", temporary=TRUE, overwrite=TRUE)

# 5. Aggregate per healthCode to reduce memory
query <- "
SELECT 
  h.healthCode,
  AVG(F0) AS F0,
  AVG(F1) AS F1,
  AVG(F2) AS F2,
  AVG(F3) AS F3
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM neg WHERE healthCode IN (SELECT healthCode FROM score_labels)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM pos WHERE healthCode IN (SELECT healthCode FROM score_labels)
) AS h
GROUP BY h.healthCode
"

agg_data <- dbGetQuery(con, query) %>% as.data.table()

# 6. Merge in motor/nonmotor labels
agg_data <- merge(agg_data, score_labels, by="healthCode")

# 7. Optional: merge gender
demo_data <- fread("C:/Users/teger/Downloads/Parkinson's Data/Demographic Survey.csv")
agg_data <- merge(agg_data, demo_data[, .(healthCode, gender)], by="healthCode", all.x=TRUE)

# 8. Reshape for plotting
plot_long <- melt(agg_data, id.vars=c("healthCode","gender","motor_group","nonmotor_group"),
                  measure.vars=c("F0","F1","F2","F3"),
                  variable.name="Feature", value.name="Value")

plot_long <- melt(plot_long, id.vars=c("healthCode","gender","Feature","Value"),
                  measure.vars=c("motor_group","nonmotor_group"),
                  variable.name="ScoreType", value.name="Group")

plot_long <- plot_long[!is.na(Group)]

# 9. Plot
ggplot(plot_long, aes(x=Group, y=Value, fill=gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size=0.5) +
  facet_grid(Feature ~ ScoreType, scales="free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
  labs(
    title="F0-F3 by Top/Bottom 10% Motor and Nonmotor Scores",
    x="Score Group",
    y="Feature Value",
    fill="Gender"
  )
```


```{r diagram}
install.packages("VennDiagram")
install.packages("stringdist")
library(VennDiagram)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringdist)


make_venn <- function(demo_data, MDS_data, neg_vals, pos_vals) {

  demo_hc <- unique(demo_data$healthCode)
  MDS_hc  <- unique(MDS_data$healthCode)

  venn.plot <- venn.diagram(
    x = list(
      Demo = demo_hc,
      MDS  = MDS_hc,
      Neg  = neg_vals,
      Pos  = pos_vals
    ),
    filename = NULL,
    fill = c("skyblue", "pink", "lightgreen", "lightyellow"),
    alpha = 0.5,
    cex = 1.5,
    cat.cex = 1.5
  )

  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(venn.plot)
}

neg_vals <- dbGetQuery(con,"SELECT DISTINCT healthCode FROM neg_dd")$healthCode
pos_vals <- dbGetQuery(con,"SELECT DISTINCT healthCode FROM pos_dd")$healthCode

make_venn(demo_data, MDS_data, neg_vals, pos_vals)
```

```{r clean report}
library(data.table)

# --- Load datasets correctly ---

mds  <- fread("C:/Users/teger/Downloads/Parkinson's Data/MDS-UPDRS Data.csv")

neg  <- as.data.table(read_parquet("C:/Users/teger/Downloads/negative (5).parquet"))
```

```{r heathcode check}
#### ============================================================
####  1.  Missingness report for *healthCode*
#### ============================================================

# Extract healthCode only if column exists
get_ids <- function(dt, col) {
  if (col %in% names(dt)) unique(dt[[col]]) else character(0)
}

demo_ids <- get_ids(demo, "healthCode")
mds_ids  <- get_ids(mds,  "healthCode")
neg_ids  <- get_ids(neg,  "healthCode")
pos_ids  <- get_ids(pos,  "healthCode")

# Union of ALL healthCodes
all_health <- unique(c(demo_ids, mds_ids, neg_ids, pos_ids))

health_report <- data.table(
  healthCode = all_health,
  missing_in_demo = !(all_health %in% demo_ids),
  missing_in_mds  = !(all_health %in% mds_ids),
  missing_in_neg  = !(all_health %in% neg_ids),
  missing_in_pos  = !(all_health %in% pos_ids)
)

health_report[, total_present :=
                (!missing_in_demo) +
                (!missing_in_mds) +
                (!missing_in_neg) +
                (!missing_in_pos)]

health_report[, total_missing :=
                (missing_in_demo) +
                (missing_in_mds) +
                (missing_in_neg) +
                (missing_in_pos)]

setorder(health_report, -total_missing)

# Save
fwrite(health_report, "missing_healthCode_report.csv")
```

```{r short summary}


library(data.table)
library(arrow)


# Helper to safely get IDs
get_ids <- function(dt, col) {
  if (col %in% names(dt)) unique(dt[[col]]) else character(0)
}

# Extract IDs
demo_h <- get_ids(demo, "healthCode");   demo_r <- get_ids(demo, "recordId")
mds_h  <- get_ids(mds,  "healthCode");   mds_r  <- get_ids(mds,  "recordId")
neg_h  <- get_ids(neg,  "healthCode");   neg_r  <- get_ids(neg,  "recordId")
pos_h  <- get_ids(pos,  "healthCode");   pos_r  <- get_ids(pos,  "recordId")

# Full unions
all_healthCodes <- unique(c(demo_h, mds_h, neg_h, pos_h))
all_recordIds   <- unique(c(demo_r, mds_r, neg_r, pos_r))

# --- Summary table ---
summary_table <- data.table(
  dataset = c("demo", "mds", "neg", "pos"),

  n_healthCode = c(length(demo_h),
                   length(mds_h),
                   length(neg_h),
                   length(pos_h)),

  missing_healthCode = c(sum(!all_healthCodes %in% demo_h),
                         sum(!all_healthCodes %in% mds_h),
                         sum(!all_healthCodes %in% neg_h),
                         sum(!all_healthCodes %in% pos_h)),

  n_recordId = c(length(demo_r),
                 length(mds_r),
                 length(neg_r),
                 length(pos_r)),

  missing_recordId = c(sum(!all_recordIds %in% demo_r),
                       sum(!all_recordIds %in% mds_r),
                       sum(!all_recordIds %in% neg_r),
                       sum(!all_recordIds %in% pos_r))
)

# --- Count subjects present in all 4 datasets ---
present_all_health <- sum(all_healthCodes %in% demo_h &
                          all_healthCodes %in% mds_h &
                          all_healthCodes %in% neg_h &
                          all_healthCodes %in% pos_h)

present_all_record <- sum(all_recordIds %in% demo_r &
                          all_recordIds %in% mds_r &
                          all_recordIds %in% neg_r &
                          all_recordIds %in% pos_r)

summary_table[, present_in_all_4_healthCode := present_all_health]
summary_table[, present_in_all_4_recordId := present_all_record]

# --- Print table ---
print(summary_table)

# --- Optional CSV export ---
fwrite(summary_table, "missingness_summary_table_with_all4.csv")


```

```{r percentage }


# Helper to safely get IDs
get_ids <- function(dt, col) {
  if (col %in% names(dt)) unique(dt[[col]]) else character(0)
}

# Extract IDs
demo_h <- get_ids(demo, "healthCode");   demo_r <- get_ids(demo, "recordId")
mds_h  <- get_ids(mds,  "healthCode");   mds_r  <- get_ids(mds,  "recordId")
neg_h  <- get_ids(neg,  "healthCode");   neg_r  <- get_ids(neg,  "recordId")
pos_h  <- get_ids(pos,  "healthCode");   pos_r  <- get_ids(pos,  "recordId")

# --- HEALTHCODE percentage match ---
all_health <- unique(c(demo_h, mds_h, neg_h, pos_h))
intersection_health <- demo_h[demo_h %in% mds_h & demo_h %in% neg_h & demo_h %in% pos_h]

pct_health_match <- length(intersection_health) / length(all_health) * 100

# --- RECORDID percentage match ---
all_record <- unique(c(demo_r, mds_r, neg_r, pos_r))
intersection_record <- demo_r[demo_r %in% mds_r & demo_r %in% neg_r & demo_r %in% pos_r]

pct_record_match <- length(intersection_record) / length(all_record) * 100

# --- Print results ---
cat("Percentage of healthCodes present in all 4 datasets:", round(pct_health_match, 2), "%\n")
cat("Percentage of recordIds present in all 4 datasets:", round(pct_record_match, 2), "%\n")
```

```{r mds vs demo}


# --- Extract IDs ---
demo_h <- unique(demo$healthCode)
mds_h  <- unique(mds$healthCode)

demo_r <- if ("recordId" %in% names(demo)) unique(demo$recordId) else character(0)
mds_r  <- if ("recordId" %in% names(mds)) unique(mds$recordId) else character(0)

# --- HEALTHCODE Overlap Table ---
health_overlap <- data.table(
  category = c("Both", "Only in Demo", "Only in MDS"),
  count = c(
    sum(demo_h %in% mds_h),          # Both
    sum(!(demo_h %in% mds_h)),       # Only in demo
    sum(!(mds_h %in% demo_h))        # Only in mds
  )
)
health_overlap[, pct := round(count / sum(count) * 100, 2)]

# --- RECORDID Overlap Table (if exists) ---
if (length(demo_r) > 0 && length(mds_r) > 0) {
  record_overlap <- data.table(
    category = c("Both", "Only in Demo", "Only in MDS"),
    count = c(
      sum(demo_r %in% mds_r),
      sum(!(demo_r %in% mds_r)),
      sum(!(mds_r %in% demo_r))
    )
  )
  record_overlap[, pct := round(count / sum(count) * 100, 2)]
} else {
  record_overlap <- data.table(
    category = c("Both", "Only in Demo", "Only in MDS"),
    count = NA,
    pct   = NA
  )
}

# --- Print results ---
cat("=== HEALTHCODE Overlap ===\n")
print(health_overlap)
cat("\n=== RECORDID Overlap ===\n")
print(record_overlap)

# --- Optional: Save as CSV ---
fwrite(health_overlap, "demo_mds_healthcode_overlap.csv")
fwrite(record_overlap, "demo_mds_recordid_overlap.csv")
```
